description: This file contains functions and variables related to managing timers for maintenance and retries in a web configuration context, including initialization, time calculations, and timer checks.

methods.name: get_global_maintenance_time
methods.description: Returns the current global maintenance time.

methods.name: set_global_maintenance_time
methods.description: Sets the global maintenance time to a specified value.

methods.name: get_retry_timer
methods.description: Returns the current retry timer value.

methods.name: set_retry_timer
methods.description: Sets the retry timer to a specified value.

methods.name: printTime
methods.description: Converts a time value to a human-readable string.

methods.name: initMaintenanceTimer
methods.description: Initializes the maintenance timer with a randomized start time based on firmware upgrade times.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceTimer
methods.description: Checks if the current time has reached or passed the maintenance time.

methods.name: getMaintenanceSyncSeconds
methods.description: Calculates seconds remaining until maintenance sync.

methods.name: retrySyncSeconds
methods.description: Calculates seconds remaining until retry timeout.

methods.name: updateRetryTimeDiff
methods.description: Updates retry timer and timestamp based on expiry time.

methods.name: getTimeInSeconds
methods.description: Converts epoch time to seconds within the current day.

methods.name: getRetryExpiryTimeout
methods.description: Returns expiry time for retry timeout set to 15 minutes from now.

methods.name: checkRetryTimer
methods.description: Checks if the current time has reached or passed the retry timestamp.
